mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-p1.title: Add up plays
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-p1.body:
Two plays take 5 minutes, so four plays take 10 minutes exactly.

**Answer: (D) 4**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-p1.title: Use seconds
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-p1.body:
The song lasts 150 seconds and the journey is 600 seconds. $600 \div 150 = 4$.

**Answer: (D) 4**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-p2.title: Euros and cents
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-p2.body:
Add the euros: $5 + 7 = 12$. Add the cents: $20 + 10 = 30$. Total €12.30.

**Answer: (C) €12.30**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-p2.title: Count on
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-p2.body:
From €5.20, add €7 to get €12.20, then 10 cents more to get €12.30.

**Answer: (C) €12.30**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-01.title: Double up
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-01.body:
4 people need $4 \times 6 = 24$ sprouts, so 8 people need twice that: 48.

**Answer: (E) 48**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-02.title: Make a table
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-02.body:
Each of the 3 patterns comes in 3 sizes, so there are $3 \times 3 = 9$ different shirts, each on its own hanger.

**Answer: (D) 9**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-02.title: List them
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-02.body:
Striped S, M, L; spotty S, M, L; plain S, M, L — that's 9 shirts, so 9 hangers.

**Answer: (D) 9**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-03.title: Add and divide
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-03.body:
Total $32 + 100 + 150 = 282$ cm. Divide by the 3 animals: $282 \div 3 = 94$ cm.

**Answer: (B) 94 cm**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-03.title: Balance around 100
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-03.body:
Compared with 100: the flea is 68 short and the frog is 50 over. Overall that is 18 short, shared between 3 animals: 6 short each. So the mean is $100 - 6 = 94$ cm.

**Answer: (B) 94 cm**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-04.title: Distance ÷ time
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-04.body:
Speed $=$ distance $\div$ time $= 171 \div 3 = 57$ million miles per hour.

**Answer: (A) 57**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-04.title: Check by multiplying
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-04.body:
At 57 million miles an hour, in 3 hours the signal travels $3 \times 57 = 171$ million miles ✓.

**Answer: (A) 57**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-05.title: Scale factor
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-05.body:
The width goes from 10 cm to 20 cm, so everything is doubled. The height becomes $15 \times 2 = 30$ cm.

**Answer: (E) 30 cm**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-05.title: Keep the shape
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-05.body:
In the original the height is $1\frac{1}{2}$ times the width ($15 = 1.5 \times 10$). The enlarged photo has the same shape, so its height is $1.5 \times 20 = 30$ cm.

**Answer: (E) 30 cm**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-06.title: Find both numbers
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-06.body:
The largest one-digit multiple of 3 is 9. The smallest two-digit multiple of 3 is 12. The difference is $12 - 9 = 3$.

**Answer: (C) 3**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-06.title: Neighbours in the 3 times table
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-06.body:
9 and 12 are next to each other in the 3 times table, so they differ by 3.

**Answer: (C) 3**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-07.title: Count the hits
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-07.body:
- Roya: 20 balls is 4 lots of 5, and she hits 4 of every 5, so $4 \times 4 = 16$ hits.
- Khalida: 20 balls is 5 lots of 4, and she hits 3 of every 4, so $5 \times 3 = 15$ hits.

Roya hits one more ball.

**Answer: (A)**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-07.title: Count the misses
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-07.body:
Roya misses 1 in every 5: 4 misses. Khalida misses 1 in every 4: 5 misses. Khalida misses one more, so Roya hits one more.

**Answer: (A)**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-08.title: Split into small triangles
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-08.body:
The large triangle is made of 4 medium triangles, and each medium triangle is made of 4 small ones. So the large triangle is worth 16 small triangles. 2 small triangles are shaded: $\frac{2}{16} = \frac{1}{8}$.

**Answer: (D) $\frac{1}{8}$**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-08.title: Fraction of a fraction
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-08.body:
Each shaded triangle is $\frac{1}{4}$ of a medium triangle, which is $\frac{1}{4}$ of the whole: $\frac{1}{4} \times \frac{1}{4} = \frac{1}{16}$. Two of them make $\frac{2}{16} = \frac{1}{8}$.

**Answer: (D) $\frac{1}{8}$**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-09.title: Share three quarters
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-09.body:
The six friends share $\frac{3}{4}$ of the cake. $\frac{3}{4} \div 6 = \frac{3}{24} = \frac{1}{8}$.

**Answer: (A) $\frac{1}{8}$**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-09.title: Cut into eighths
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-09.body:
Cut the cake into 8 equal slices. Sandy keeps $\frac{1}{4}$, which is 2 slices. The other 6 slices go one each to the 6 friends. So Mo gets 1 slice, $\frac{1}{8}$.

**Answer: (A) $\frac{1}{8}$**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-10.title: Look at the angles
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-10.body:
Each triangle has angles 90°, 45° and 45°. Any corner of a shape made from them is built from these angles, so it is 45°, 90°, 135°, ... — always a multiple of 45°. An equilateral triangle needs 60° corners, so it can never be made.

The others can be made: two triangles joined along their long sides give a square (a square is also a rhombus); joined along a short side they give a bigger right-angled isosceles triangle; sliding one triangle part of the way along the other's side gives a six-sided shape.

**Answer: (D) equilateral triangle**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-11.title: Add it up
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-11.body:
There are 5 weekdays: $5 \times 100 = 500$ ml. Add the weekend: $500 + 250 = 750$ ml. Since 1 litre $= 1000$ ml, 750 ml $= 0.75$ litres.

**Answer: (B) 0.75**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-11.title: Think in quarters of a litre
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-11.body:
250 ml is a quarter of a litre and 500 ml is half a litre. A half plus a quarter is three quarters, 0.75 litres.

**Answer: (B) 0.75**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-12.title: The gap stays the same
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-12.body:
My mother is always $38 - 14 = 24$ years older than me. If she is twice my age, the gap of 24 years equals my age. So I am 24 (and she is 48).

**Answer: (C) 24**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-13.title: Big square minus corners
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-13.body:
Each side of the big square is cut into 4 cm and 8 cm. The four corner triangles are right-angled with sides 4 cm and 8 cm, so each has area $\frac{1}{2} \times 4 \times 8 = 16$ cm². The big square has area $12 \times 12 = 144$ cm². The small square is $144 - 4 \times 16 = 80$ cm².

**Answer: (D) 80 cm²**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-13.title: Rearrange the triangles
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-13.body:
Two corner triangles together make a 4 cm by 8 cm rectangle (32 cm²), so the four of them make 64 cm². The small square is what is left of 144 cm²: $144 - 64 = 80$ cm².

**Answer: (D) 80 cm²**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-14.title: Work out each one
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-14.body:
- A: $\frac{8}{4} + \frac{8}{4} = 2 + 2 = 4$
- B: $\frac{64}{16} = 4$
- C: $16 \div 4 = 4$
- D: $\frac{256}{64} = 4$ (four 4s on top, three underneath, leaving one 4)
- E: $\frac{88}{44} = 2$ ✗

**Answer: (E)**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-14.title: Spot it quickly
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-14.body:
In E, the top is just two lots of 44, so dividing by 44 gives 2, not 4.

**Answer: (E)**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-15.title: Count in parts
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-15.body:
Call the number of onions 1 part. Carrots are 2 parts and potatoes are 4 parts. Altogether $1 + 2 + 4 = 7$ parts $= 84$, so 1 part is $84 \div 7 = 12$ onions.

**Answer: (C) 12**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-15.title: Try the options
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-15.body:
12 onions gives 24 carrots and 48 potatoes: $12 + 24 + 48 = 84$ ✓. (With 14 onions the total would be 98, too many.)

**Answer: (C) 12**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-16.title: Percentage of a percentage
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-16.body:
After one translation 80% of the meaning is left. The second translation keeps 80% of that: 80% of 80% is $0.8 \times 0.8 = 0.64$, i.e. 64%.

**Answer: (D) 64%**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-16.title: Start with 100 units
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-16.body:
Start with 100 units of meaning. Losing 20% leaves 80. Losing 20% of 80 (that's 16) leaves 64. So 64% is left.

**Answer: (D) 64%**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-17.title: Add the five faces
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-17.body:
The tank has no metal top, so there are 5 metal faces:
- front and back: $2 \times (3 \times 2) = 12$ m²
- two ends: $2 \times (1 \times 2) = 4$ m²
- base: $3 \times 1 = 3$ m²

Total $12 + 4 + 3 = 19$ m².

**Answer: (D) 19 m²**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-17.title: Whole box minus the top
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-17.body:
A closed box would have surface area $2 \times (3 \times 1 + 3 \times 2 + 1 \times 2) = 2 \times 11 = 22$ m². Taking away the top ($3 \times 1 = 3$ m²) leaves 19 m².

**Answer: (D) 19 m²**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-18.title: Spot the pattern
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-18.body:
The press-ups are 1, 3, 5, 7, ... — the odd numbers, going up by 2 each day. Twice the day number gives 2, 4, 6, ..., which is always 1 more than the press-ups. So day $n$ has $2n - 1$ press-ups.

**Answer: (C) $2n - 1$**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-18.title: Test the formulas
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-18.body:
On day 1 there is 1 press-up: $n - 1 = 0$ ✗, $n = 1$, $2n - 1 = 1$, $2n = 2$ ✗, $2n + 1 = 3$ ✗. On day 2 there are 3: $n = 2$ ✗ but $2n - 1 = 3$ ✓.

**Answer: (C) $2n - 1$**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-19.title: Cut into small triangles
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-19.body:
The triangle has 3 sides and the hexagon 6, with the same perimeter, so each triangle side is twice a hexagon side. Join the midpoints of the triangle's sides: it splits into 4 small equilateral triangles with sides equal to the hexagon's side. The hexagon splits (from its centre) into 6 of these same small triangles. The ratio is $4 : 6 = 2 : 3$.

**Answer: (D) 2 : 3**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-20.title: Multiply up
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-20.body:
The length of the hand isn't needed. Each hour the tip travels about 27 m.
- In a day: $27 \times 24 = 648$ m.
- In a year: $648 \times 365 = 236\,520$ m, about 237 km.

The nearest answer is 240 km.

**Answer: (E) 240 km**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-20.title: Estimate
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-20.body:
In a day the tip travels about $27 \times 24 \approx 650$ m. A year is a bit less than 400 days, and $650 \times 400 = 260\,000$ m $= 260$ km, so the true distance is a bit under 260 km. Only 240 km is close; the other options are far too small.

**Answer: (E) 240 km**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-21.title: Overlap as much as possible
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-21.body:
At least 18 friends want to do something (the charity-shop helpers). If all the reading helpers and animal helpers are among those 18, then exactly 18 want to help with something and $20 - 18 = 2$ want to do none. It can't be more than 2, because 18 friends already want to help in the shop.

**Answer: (B) 2**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-22.title: Use a common time
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-22.body:
Joe takes 140 minutes per box; together they take 60 minutes per box. In 420 minutes (a multiple of both):
- Joe sharpens $420 \div 140 = 3$ boxes,
- together they sharpen $420 \div 60 = 7$ boxes,
- so Josie sharpens $7 - 3 = 4$ boxes.

Josie takes $420 \div 4 = 105$ minutes per box, which is 1 hour 45 minutes.

**Answer: (D) 1 hour 45 mins**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-22.title: Fractions of a box per minute
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-22.body:
Joe does $\frac{1}{140}$ of a box per minute; together they do $\frac{1}{60}$. Josie does $\frac{1}{60} - \frac{1}{140} = \frac{7}{420} - \frac{3}{420} = \frac{4}{420} = \frac{1}{105}$ of a box per minute, so she takes 105 minutes.

**Answer: (D) 1 hour 45 mins**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-23.title: Convert French hours
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-23.body:
The clock shows 3 o'clock in French time (hour hand on 3, minute hand on 0). A French hour lasts $24 \div 10 = 2.4$ of our hours. So 3 French hours is $3 \times 2.4 = 7.2$ hours. $0.2$ of an hour is $0.2 \times 60 = 12$ minutes, so the time is 7.12 a.m.

**Answer: (D) 7.12 a.m.**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-23.title: Fraction of the day
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-23.body:
3 out of 10 French hours is $\frac{3}{10}$ of the day. $\frac{3}{10}$ of 24 hours is 7.2 hours, i.e. 7 hours 12 minutes after midnight.

**Answer: (D) 7.12 a.m.**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-24.title: Digit sums
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-24.body:
The 16 numbers are 789, 987, 456, 654, 123, 321, 741, 147, 852, 258, 963, 369, 753, 357, 159 and 951. In every line of three keys the digits add to a multiple of 3 (for example $7 + 8 + 9 = 24$, $7 + 4 + 1 = 12$, $7 + 5 + 3 = 15$). So every one of the numbers is a multiple of 3, and none is prime.

**Answer: (A) 0**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-24.title: Middle digit trick
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-24.body:
In each straight line through three keys, the middle key is the average of the two end keys (e.g. 8 is halfway between 7 and 9, 5 between 1 and 9). So the digit sum is 3 times the middle digit, always a multiple of 3. Every number is divisible by 3: no primes.

**Answer: (A) 0**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-25.title: Do the check
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-25.body:
The digits are 9, 7, 8, 0, 9, 0, 6, 5, 8, 8, 9, ?, 7.
- Even places: $7 + 0 + 0 + 5 + 8 + ? = 20 + ?$, tripled: $60 + 3 \times ?$.
- Odd places: $9 + 8 + 9 + 6 + 8 + 9 + 7 = 56$.

Total $116 + 3 \times ?$ must be a multiple of 10, so $3 \times ?$ must end in 4. Only $3 \times 8 = 24$ works (total 140).

**Answer: (E) 8**

mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-25.title: Test the options
mapmc-pmc-bonus-2022-25.body:
The total is $116 + 3 \times ?$: with 0, 1, 2, 6, 8 we get 116, 119, 122, 134, 140. Only 140 is divisible by 10.

**Answer: (E) 8**
